scope: Fresh problem formulations after adapter implementation; no query tuning, no held-out superiority claim. Reaction/permanence, passive phonons and source-replay topics have prior task context. Problems are outside executable regression fixtures.

cases.problem: A reaction network has positive mass action rates that vary with time. Can a permanence argument keep every species away from extinction when the rates are allowed to approach zero? State the rate assumptions needed before reuse.

An adaptive learning experiment acquires labels from a finite candidate pool. I want to replace that pool with a generator that changes after observing labels. What acquisition guarantee remains usable, and which premise would have to be supplied again?

I can redistribute a fixed passive phonon resource across a scalar periodic medium. Can a formula that maximizes an asymptotic transport coefficient be used to promise a measured room temperature device improvement? Recover the model and its limitations.

A catalyst replay predicts better ammonia yield after changing isotope composition. I need a usable comparison that includes mixing consistency and ordinary matched baselines, rather than a raw simulated gain.

I have a finite canonical memory coupled to a bath and want a frequency dependent response. Which finite resource construction can I reuse without assuming an infinite reservoir or free initialization?
Give an experimentally demonstrated Astra device that provides unlimited work from a single equilibrium heat bath with no reset cost.
